next.heading: What happens next
next.staff: The ROPS team is notified straight away — through the bell in the staff panel.
next.staffWithEmail: The ROPS team is notified straight away — through the bell in the staff panel and by e-mail.
next.ai: An AI assistant sorts the case and prepares a draft reply. A person reads and corrects the draft — nothing is sent without them.
next.reply: The reply will appear on your case page ({code}){channel, select, email { and come to you by e-mail.} sms { and you'll get a text message telling you.} phone {. A member of ROPS staff will call you to pass it on.} other {. You can check it with your case code.}}
next.noteOff: This version of the service doesn't send e-mails, and text messages are only simulated — you'll see the reply on your case page.
next.noteDemo: Demo version: text messages are only simulated (we save them but don't send them), and e-mails go only to demo addresses — a message to any other address is only saved.
next.noteSms: In this prototype text messages are only simulated — you'll always see the reply on your case page.
